title: Croatian Boudin Noir Skillet
description: A rich and flavorful Croatian dish featuring boudin noir, pickles, and Mediterranean spices, perfect for a quick and satisfying meal. This recipe combines the richness of boudin noir with the tanginess of pickles and the warmth of Mediterranean spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced boudin noir and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped pickles, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the chopped parsley and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
